stories.headline: The Ridge Has a Name: Christine's Annotation Published; Steve's Middle Two Words Resolved; the Hollow Has Given Back Everything It Had
stories.byline: By our Highland Correspondent, filing from the kitchen table
body: It can now be confirmed. The single-word annotation added by Christine to the third chart mark — held in reserve for four days while the paper observed appropriate editorial restraint — is 'Keeps.' The ridge above Harlan's Hollow is henceforth named Keeps Ridge, for reasons that are her own and require no further editorial elaboration, except to note that the word was also Steve's fourth margin word, and that neither of them had told the other.

This coincidence resolved the remaining two words. His second and third margin entries, rendered here in full for the first time, are 'the' and 'warmth.' The complete phrase — ridge, the, warmth, keeps — reads in the order he wrote them, which is to say, in the order the ridge offered them. The flint stone, still warm to the touch this morning by all household accounts, now sits at the head of the kitchen table. The chart has been folded along the new mark. The Jeep, clean for the first time since Friday, stands in the drive facing north-northeast.
The hollow has given back what it had. The paper considers this matter closed, and the ridge named, and the stone exactly where it belongs.

stories.headline: Monday Arrives in Good Order; Christine Returns to the Bank; the Bank Visibly Straightens Up
body: Following a weekend of ridge-naming and flint assessment, the Senior Client Liaison returned to Gringotts this morning at her customary hour, and the building — according to three junior tellers, one head goblin, and the left-hand gargoyle — adjusted its posture accordingly. Two accounts that had been circling unresolved since Thursday were settled before the first owl post.

Griphook the Younger submitted his Monday briefing without protest, which sources describe as 'unprecedented,' 'suspicious,' and 'probably fine.' Christine accepted it, amended one figure, and handed it back. He did not object to the amendment. He has not been seen since, but is believed to be sitting quietly somewhere, reflecting.

stories.headline: Duck Subcommittee Receives Final Arc Report; Files It Under 'Resolved'; Immediately Begins Worrying About the Next One
body: The Ministry's Duck Subcommittee, which adjourned indefinitely on Sunday to recover from the southward-reorientation revelation, reconvened briefly this morning upon learning that the Harlan's Hollow arc had reached formal resolution. The subcommittee reviewed the complete duck record — arrival date, mirror position, north-northeast bearing, southward reorientation at the second waymarker, and subsequent restoration by Steve — and filed it as the most comprehensively documented duck event in subcommittee history.

The committee chair noted, in closing remarks, that the duck's behaviour across the Hollow expedition had 'implied intentionality at a level inconsistent with standard rubber.' The duck was not available for comment. It is on the Jeep's mirror, facing north-northeast, and appears to be waiting.

stories.headline: Ministry Issues Monday Bulletin; Acknowledges the Ridge Now Has a Name; Asks, Gently, If It May Add Keeps Ridge to the Map; the Map Committee Has Been Waiting Years for Something Like This
body: The Ministry of Magic's Cartographic Subcommittee — a body that has not issued a meaningful bulletin since the Unplottable Reclassification of 2019 — sent an owl to the kitchen table this morning requesting formal permission to add 'Keeps Ridge' to the official Highland Hollow Survey. The owl waited patiently by the flint stone for a reply.

Christine has not yet responded. The Subcommittee says it will wait. The map has a blank space above the second circle of Harlan's Hollow that has been bothering them since the survey was first drawn, and they are, if anything, relieved.

familiars_corner: Lucy: The stone has been on the table for three days, and Lucy has not touched it, which is itself the most suspicious thing she has done all weekend — several parties have noted this aloud, and she has declined to comment, which is also suspicious.

Ellie: Ellie approached the flint stone this morning with great interest, sniffed it for approximately forty-five seconds, and then looked at the window, apparently satisfied; her formal assessment, if she has one, has not been filed.
Jersey: Jersey has identified the folded chart as an acceptable chin-rest and has been stationed at the kitchen table since seven-thirty, content, warm, and directly on top of Keeps Ridge.
founding_editor_note: That stone'll hold the chart flat better than any paperweight I could've built — and I could've built a good one. — D.

in_brief.sport: The Gringotts Invitational Weightlifting Circuit notes that the flint from Keeps Ridge, though small, is denser than regulation and has been flagged for review.
in_brief.forecast: Clear skies through the hollows · the chart is folded · the duck is ready · whatever comes next is already being waited for.

storyline_updates.title: What the Hollow Gave Back
storyline_updates.summary: Resolved Monday morning. The ridge above Harlan's Hollow is now named Keeps Ridge — Christine's annotation and Steve's fourth margin word, independently arrived at, identical. His complete four-word phrase: 'ridge the warmth keeps.' The flint stone sits at the head of the kitchen table. The chart is folded along the new mark. The duck faces north-northeast. The hollow has given back everything it had. The arc is closed.

storyline_updates.title: The Duck Waits
storyline_updates.summary: New arc to open in the next day or two. The duck on the Jeep's mirror has been facing north-northeast since Steve restored it Saturday. The Ministry's subcommittee noted it appears to be 'waiting.' A new duck — different colour, different posture — will be found on the Jeep within the next edition or two, left by the Duck Bandit. The arc will trace the slow revelation of who the Bandit is, what they know about the ridge, and whether the original duck is somehow involved. Day 1 should be the discovery of the new duck.
